name: coreutils-small-15

canonical_archive_member_exclusions.reason: Install's translated closure supplies the shared copy engine before the canonical cp entry point is resolved. The no-security compile actions differ only in renamed main/usage macros; retain cp.c while removing the four duplicate public helper objects, then revalidate both applets through the complete GNU suite.

c_normalization.expected_before:
ok &= copy_internal (src_name, dst_name, dst_dirfd,
                           dst_name + (dst_relname_in - dst_name_in),
                           new_dst, src_sb,
                           ancestors, &non_command_line_options, false,
                           &first_dir_created,
                           &local_copy_into_self, &rename_succeeded);
c_normalization.replacement:
ok = copy_internal (src_name, dst_name, dst_dirfd,
                          dst_name + (dst_relname_in - dst_name_in),
                          new_dst, src_sb,
                          ancestors, &non_command_line_options, false,
                          &first_dir_created,
                          &local_copy_into_self, &rename_succeeded) && ok;
c_normalization.reason: Evaluate every recursive copy eagerly before explicitly accumulating its Boolean result.
Spell copy's Boolean copy-into-self accumulation without compound bitwise assignment.
Spell copy's Boolean first-directory accumulation without compound bitwise assignment.
Make install's inode hash conversions explicit without the scalar compound literal.
Make the standard integer conversion from idx_t to off_t explicit at the checked-add boundary.

c_normalization.expected_before:
if (xstrtoumax (owner_name, NULL, 0, &tmp, "") != LONGINT_OK
              || ckd_add (&owner_id, tmp, 0))
            error (EXIT_FAILURE, 0, _("invalid user %s"),
                   quoteaf (owner_name));
c_normalization.reason: Spell install's checked uintmax_t-to-uid_t conversion as an explicit range check and assignment.

c_normalization.expected_before:
if (xstrtoumax (group_name, NULL, 0, &tmp, "") != LONGINT_OK

            error (EXIT_FAILURE, 0, _("invalid group %s"),

c_normalization.reason: Spell install's checked uintmax_t-to-gid_t conversion as an explicit range check and assignment.

selection_policy: The no-security install closure is translated independently from cp and mv because all three compile the shared copy engine with applet-specific definitions; install additionally owns install.c and prog-fprintf.c, and C2Rust requires unique source paths within each translation batch.
